hypotheses.capacity_assumption: Hourly BTC swap bars; position changes are charged seven bps and no capacity claim is made before L2 evidence.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Reject if either development segment has non-positive net annualized return or if campaign statistics fail after all trials are counted.
hypotheses.hypothesis: A four-hour price displacement that is extreme relative to the prior day mean-reverts over the next hour after explicit costs.
hypotheses.rationale: Inventory pressure and short-lived liquidation flow can push price beyond a one-hour equilibrium before liquidity replenishes.

hypotheses.capacity_assumption: Hourly BTC swap bars; volume is only a coarse participation proxy and cannot establish executable size.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Reject if cost-adjusted edge is non-positive, drawdown exceeds the development gate, or walk-forward and multiple-testing gates do not all pass.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Eight-hour directional continuation is more likely to persist for one additional hour when current volume ranks high within the prior day.
hypotheses.rationale: Price moves accompanied by elevated participation may reflect information arrival rather than low-liquidity noise.

hypotheses.capacity_assumption: Funding is an hourly aligned research field; no assumption is made about exchange settlement timing beyond the recorded cost model.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Reject if low funding does not predict positive next-hour net return in both train and valid or any campaign statistical gate fails.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Unusually low funding marks crowded short positioning whose next-hour unwind creates a positive long-side return after costs.
hypotheses.rationale: Funding extremes proxy positioning pressure; negative funding can precede short covering when the imbalance cannot deepen.

hypotheses.capacity_assumption: The signal uses closed hourly bars and the prior 24 highs only; bar volume does not prove fill capacity.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Reject if sparse breakouts cannot overcome seven bps of turnover cost or if stability, bootstrap, Holm, DSR, or walk-forward gates fail.
hypotheses.hypothesis: A close above the highest high of the previous 24 completed bars continues upward for one hour after explicit costs.
hypotheses.rationale: A new daily-range close can reveal persistent information flow when the comparison excludes the current bar.
